property.name: storyOffset
property.shortdesc: The insertion point before the table in the story containing the table.

property.name: id
property.shortdesc: The unique ID of the XMLInstruction.

property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the XMLInstruction (a Document or XMLElement).

property.name: index
property.shortdesc: The index of the XMLInstruction within its containing object.

property.name: target
property.shortdesc: A name that identifies the processing instruction to an application reading the exported XML file.

property.name: data
property.shortdesc: A value that tells the application reading the exported XML file what to do with the processing instruction.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: move
method.shortdesc: Moves the element to the specified location.

parameter.name: to
parameter.shortdesc: The location in relation to the reference object or within the containing object.

parameter.name: reference
parameter.shortdesc: The reference object. Note: Required when the to parameter specifies before or after. . Can accept: XMLItem or Text. (Optional)

parameter.name: existingSelection
parameter.shortdesc: The selection status of the XMLInstruction in relation to previously selected objects. (Optional)

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the XMLInstruction.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
